notes.title: Marble Muse Arcade
notes.notes:
We've been hard at work on the next game in this series and we are finally ready to release to you [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1561860/Marble_Muse_Arcade/]Marble Muse Arcade[/url]! 

[h2]What's new?[/h2]
While this game borrows the same basic mechanics of the original Marble Muse game, the movement is much faster paced and the goal of the game has changed significantly. Instead of collecting all the stars to complete a level, the goal in Marble Muse Arcade is to reach the end platform before the time runs out and collect as many points as you can along the way. The game ends when you run out of lives. In this way Marble Muse Arcade has a very classic arcade feel. In fact, this game was originally created to be played in a full arcade machine and still has support for classic arcade controls. 

A lot of new features have been added such as higher point value stars, multiplier stars, time bonuses and combos! We've also added a two player mode, where two players can take turns competing for the high score. If you've ever playing classic pinball games, you'll feel right at home. There's 3 leaderboards in this game: global leaderboard, friends leaderboard, and optionally a local leaderboard in the case that you want to run this game on site in an arcade machine.

[h2]What's the same?[/h2]
You'll see a lot that is familiar in this game and that is because Marble Muse Arcade was built upon the building blocks of the original Marble Muse game. The control mechanics are largely the same and the levels are mashups of Marble Muse levels. We hope this familiarity along with all that's new will create a fun and exciting experience for all.

Marble Muse Arcade will be coming out May 10th. Be sure to [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1561860/Marble_Muse_Arcade/]add to your wish list[/url]!


[b]One more thing![/b] We are doing something different in Marble Muse Arcade. For those that get the Legend achievement, you will have the opportunity to receive a 3D printed award! (While supplies last)

notes.title: Update 1.1 - Now With a Level Creator!
notes.notes:
When you complete all the levels in the game, the level creator will be unlocked! Have fun creating your own levels using pieces from all the different types of stages together!

Release notes:
[list]
 [*]New level creator (Unlocked after completing all 24 levels).
 [*]Made medal times easier to achieve.
 [*]Improved marble control and movement.
 [*]Improved design of "Tubes and Ladders"
 [*]Improved design of  "Castle"
 [*]Improved design on "Disc Changer"
 [*]Improved performance of levels with lots of stars.
 [*]Improved framerate detection.
 [*]Fixed an audio settings issue.
 [*]Fixed a level loading issue.
[/list]
